Our story

Sip.Relax.Enjoy the garden.

Paradise Kafé is a little garden escape in the middle of Bethlehem. Our tree is rooted deep and always blooming, just like the café: classic coffee and tea traditions from Arabic coffee to karak chai, growing into playful matcha and dessert creations you won't find anywhere else.

Garden vibes

A calm, green corner to slow down, catch up with friends or get lost in a book.

Layered matcha

Fruit, milk and matcha stacked into drinks as pretty as they are good.

Made with love

Fresh-baked pies, crêpes and croissants made to order, every day.
